thread:
sarah: heads-up — after yesterday's rollback the nightly SAST rerun surfaced a cluster of failures that look like KMS decrypt errors. need to replay and capture audit proof for compliance.

scan-bot: nightly-scan v2 finished: 42 findings, 12 errors. Error summary: KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR during artifact fetch.

jamal: thanks. any job id so I can re-run locally? I can request a short-lived grant.

sarah: job id job/2026-03-19/gh-nightly-7. reproducer steps in a sec.

mike: if the ephemeral grant expired mid-fetch the scanner will mark missing libs as issues -> makes a bunch of FPs. do not auto-suppress until we confirm.

alyssa: @jamal can you run a constrained replay that captures keystore audit events (decrypt success/failure + principal)? we need that for the evidence bundle.

jamal: on it. running: ```replay-scanner --job=job/2026-03-19/gh-nightly-7 --since=2026-03-19T22:00Z --keystore=ephemeral --capture-audit=/tmp/replay-audit.log``` will ping when done.

scan-bot: FYI replay will hit quota checks; permitted window 23:30-01:00 UTC.

mike: also check infra: there was an RBAC change last week that reverted repo-admins -> scanner-service binding. timing matches.

sarah: path forward: (1) jamal replay + audit capture (2) mike triage RBAC binding + open PR if needed (3) alyssa preserve evidence in compliance bucket with checksum + timestamp (4) security holds suppression decisions until artifacts verified.

jamal: replay started. attaching logs when complete.

scan-bot: replay finished: 0 KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR, 12 findings remain. Audit log saved: /tmp/replay-audit.log

alyssa: uploading audit bundle to gs://compliance-evidence/redwood/sast/2026-03-19/job-2026-03-19-7.log sha256: abcdef1234567890... :lock:

mike: RBAC change confirmed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/keystore-fix (requesting @infra-oncall review).

sarah: confirmed — the original errors were due to an expired ephemeral grant during artifact fetch. note for postmortem: add a pre-replay RBAC/binding check and tag replays with a do-not-suppress flag for 72h.

jamal: i'll open a short runbook PR with the exact replay command and audit capture steps.

alyssa: tagging @compliance for visibility.

compliance: evidence received. we consider this a non-regression but require audit trails retained for 90 days and bucket-level immutability for this object.

sarah: closing loop: action items assigned and runbook PR expected. :white_check_mark:
